name: Jangmo-o
description: The Scaly Pokémon. It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.

abilities.name: À Prova de Som
abilities.description: Imune a movimentos baseados em som.

abilities.name: Sobretudo
abilities.description: Este Pokémon não sofre dano de efeitos climáticos ou movimentos relacionados ao clima.
